page_title: CRY 1-0 TOT | Crystal Palace v Tottenham Hotspur 27/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Darren Bond is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+4' Tottenham slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) comes onto the pitch so that Adam Wharton can be given a rest.
87' Ange Postecoglou decides to make a substitution. Yves Bissouma will be replaced by Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham).
85' Darren Bond shows a yellow card to Richarlison (Tottenham) for his blatant foul.
83' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

83' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Guglielmo Vicario stops the ball from going inside right post. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Crystal Palace.
80' Timo Werner (Tottenham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
77' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Richarlison, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
77' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Will Hughes (Crystal Palace).
75' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
72' The free kick is taken by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace), but ball is cleared.
70' A pass from Richarlison (Tottenham) is intercepted by Dean Henderson and the move breaks down.

68' A sweet pass finds Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. Guglielmo Vicario is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
67' Here comes a substitution. Ismaila Sarr is given a rest as he is replaced by Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace).
65' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) receives a yellow card.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Richarlison (Tottenham) will replace James Maddison.
62' Ange Postecoglou has decided to substitute Dejan Kulusevski and he is replaced by Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham).
62' Ange Postecoglou has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Timo Werner (Tottenham) replacing Mikey Moore.
61' A yellow card is awarded to Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace).
60' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

59' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.

58' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) produced a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Guglielmo Vicario thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
57' The corner kick from Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
55' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
52' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
51' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Crystal Palace players look gutted.
51' Wait! Referee Darren Bond has indicated he is going to review the Crystal Palace goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
50' Goaal - Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace)!
49' Mikey Moore (Tottenham) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
49' Tottenham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

49' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Dean Henderson shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Tottenham get a corner.

47' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the left post. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.

46' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Darren Bond blows for a foul. Crystal Palace win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' Darren Bond has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+6' Mikey Moore (Tottenham) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
45+5' Excellent touch by James Maddison (Tottenham)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.
45+4' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
45+4' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) swings in a cross from the corner, but Guglielmo Vicario reads it well and gathers the ball.

45+4' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

45+2' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
44' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

44' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) produces a poor lofted pass into the penalty box. His attempt is easily thwarted by the defence. Crystal Palace force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
41' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren Bond had an easy-decision to make.
39' James Maddison (Tottenham) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

39' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The linesman makes the right call and Tottenham will have a corner.
37' What was Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
36' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
36' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The linesman points to the corner flag, Crystal Palace are going to take it.
35' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) fails to score from inside the six-yard box as he sends his rebound against the left post.
34' James Maddison (Tottenham) will take a corner kick.
34' James Maddison (Tottenham) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The referee blows his whistle, Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
32' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) was quite harsh and Darren Bond didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
31' 1 - 0 Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low in the middle of the goal.

30' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Guglielmo Vicario sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post.
30' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball has crossed the sideline. Tottenham are taking a throw-in.

27' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
27' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

27' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee points to the corner flag and Crystal Palace will take a corner.
22' Jefferson Lerma is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace).
21' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
20' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) sprays a pass out to Dominic Solanke, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
18' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
17' Darren Bond blows for a foul after Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Crystal Palace are awarded a free kick.
14' Mikey Moore (Tottenham) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
14' Mikey Moore (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Corner kick. Tottenham will have an opportunity.
13' Mikey Moore (Tottenham) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
13' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Tottenham will take a corner kick.
11' Darren Bond couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) and blew his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Tottenham.
10' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.

7' It could have been a good chance to score! Mikey Moore (Tottenham) fails to release Destiny Udogie with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
6' The ball is cleared after Mikey Moore (Tottenham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Tottenham will have a throw-in.
3' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

3' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The referee signals a corner kick to Crystal Palace.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Tottenham will have the kick-off.
Darren Bond will officiate today.
